## Description {#details}

The <Link to="/docs/api/namespaces/micro-os-plus">micro&#95;os&#95;plus</Link> namespace provides a dedicated scope for all µOS++ classes, functions, variables, enumerations, type definitions, and related entities.

This namespace is further structured into additional nested namespaces. By encapsulating definitions within distinct namespaces, the framework achieves improved code organisation, reduced redundancy, and enhanced maintainability.

Such an approach fosters modular development and ensures seamless integration within µOS++, thereby contributing to a more efficient and scalable system.
